title: Specification multiverse
confidence: Ready to share with explicit scope
key_result: Across 32 specifications Sheffield is top five in 21 but ranges from rank 1 to 15; Crawley ranges from 1 to 27 and London from 1 to 35.
main_limit: Specifications differ in eligibility and receive equal descriptive weight; ranges are not probability intervals.

title: Scene depth and concentration
key_result: London has 20.2 effective bands while Crawley's 3.59x follower output quotient rests on an effective-band count of 1.0.
main_limit: The mapped top-1000 catalogue is not a census and missing smaller bands can bias depth more than follower output.

title: Generations by decade
key_result: MusicBrainz formation-year coverage is 108 of 200 bands and uneven enough that no city ranking is defensible.
main_limit: Coverage is 54 percent overall and zero in two FUAs; the result is about data readiness rather than music-city generations.

title: Genre-specific city histories
key_result: Wikidata provides genre for 924 of 1,000 bands and inception year for 822; 599 mapped bands have both.
main_limit: Broad automated genre families erase meaningful lineages and formation years still need review and period-appropriate denominators.

title: Scene infrastructure
key_result: Raw mapped-place count correlates 0.72 with effective-band count but infrastructure per capita correlates only 0.14 with follower output quotient.
main_limit: The inventory is current OpenStreetMap data in 15 km circles; city size mapping effort and historical mismatch prevent causal interpretation.

title: Band networks
key_result: Among 660 mapped top-1,000 bands, the graph contains 272 shared-member pairs and 5,786 shared-label pairs; 240 bands have a documented member connection.
main_limit: Relationship coverage is incomplete and label links often describe industry structure rather than local scene interaction.

title: Longitudinal platform reach
confidence: Share only as a two-point diagnostic
key_result: All 50 bands gain followers but only 28 gain monthly listeners; change ranks correlate only 0.23.
main_limit: There are only two observations and the extraction method changed; releases tours and viral events are not annotated.

title: Beyond Spotify
key_result: English Wikipedia coverage is 955 of 1,000 and its rank correlation with Spotify followers is 0.78.
main_limit: Pageviews measure English-language attention over a year while followers are a point-in-time stock; residuals may reflect identity matching or news events.
